itens.titulo: September Surprise: Hymn to Tourach in Historic
itens.resumo: Aneurin presents four decklists - two Mono-Black (very different from each other), a Rakdos aggro and a Jund Goyfs one - that take advantage of the card Hymn to Tourach, which was recently added to Historic.

itens.titulo: I Have No Idea What Makes a Magic Set Good (You Probably Don’t Either)
itens.resumo: Ryan grapples with the concept of quality in Magic set design. How do we evaluate it, and are we giving sets a fair look when we do?

itens.titulo: Content Creation and Social Media is Flattening Magic: the Gathering
itens.resumo: This week Plum gets a little serious and gives his thoughts on how the rapid growth of MTG interacts with modern day social media.

itens.titulo: Mecânicas de Reality Fracture explicadas - Chama o Juiz!

itens.titulo: Legacy: Análise de Bilbo, Thief in the Night - O Veredito!
itens.resumo: Bilbo, Thief in the Night, já habita o Legacy tempo suficiente para que possamos passar o Veredito: carta absurda que não deveria existir ou muito papo e pouca ação? Nesse artigo, vamos analisar onde ele se posiciona no Metagame!

itens.titulo: The Anti-Meta Deck Standard Needs: Dimir Tempo
itens.resumo: The MTG Hero is tired of playing the big four of Standard. This week he is diving into the anti-meta! Is it good enough?

itens.titulo: Finding the best Fight Rigging list in Historic
itens.resumo: Aneeurin presents his most winning Fight Rigging decklist, with a couple of unusual choices (plus a bonus Devotion Rigging list at the end)
